longForm.heroHook: 750 watts of programmable ultrasonic power, from 200 µL microsamples up to 2 L batches.
longForm.heroLead: Cell lysis, homogenization, emulsification, or nanoparticle dispersion all demand different amounts of ultrasonic energy delivered precisely, not just applied longer or shorter. VCX-750 gives you that precision directly. A 750 W, 20 kHz microprocessor-based system, it's fully programmable through intuitive, easy-to-navigate screens, with energy setpoint and temperature monitoring built in for reproducible results across every run. A standard ½" diameter titanium alloy probe with a replaceable tip ships with the system, and a wide range of horns and accessories extends processing across 200 µL to 2 L, depending on the probe or accessory selected.

sections.title: Product Information
sections.description: VCX-750 product information: power delivery, control features, and probe and accessory options.
body: The system runs at 750 W maximum output and 20 kHz frequency, delivering enough power to drive the largest assortment of horns and accessories in the VCX range.
Control is fully programmable through a microprocessor-based interface, with intuitive, easy-to-navigate screens rather than a fixed dial or switch setup.
Energy setpoint control lets you dose sonication by Joules delivered rather than time alone, which is what makes results reproducible run to run regardless of small variations in sample consistency.
Temperature monitoring runs alongside energy dosing, so heat-sensitive samples can be tracked and protected during processing.
A pulse mode is available for applications needing intermittent rather than continuous sonication, useful for reducing sample heating during longer runs.
Wattage and energy are both displayed directly during operation, giving real-time visibility into exactly how much energy a sample has received.
A 10-hour timer covers everything from short bursts to extended processing runs.
A standard ½" diameter probe with a replaceable titanium alloy tip ships with the base VCX-750 configuration, alongside a tool kit for probe maintenance.

sections.eyebrow: Reproducible Sonication Through Energy Setpoint Control
sections.title: Reproducible Sonication Through Energy Setpoint Control
sections.description: Timing a sonication run by seconds alone assumes every sample absorbs energy at the same rate, and that assumption rarely holds across different batches, viscosities, or sample volumes. VCX-750's energy setpoint control sidesteps that problem entirely by dosing sonication in Joules delivered rather than time elapsed. Two samples that process at different rates still receive the same total energy input, keeping results comparable across a study or production run. Temperature monitoring runs in parallel, so a run that's delivering energy efficiently and heating a sample faster than expected can be caught and managed before it affects results. Wattage and energy both display in real time, so the actual dose delivered is always visible, not just the setpoint targeted.

sections.title: Probe, Converter, and Accessory Options
sections.description: Matching VCX-750's probe and accessory choices to your sample volume and application.
body: A 750 W system is only as useful as the hardware attached to it, and the range of compatible probes and accessories is what lets VCX-750 cover such a wide processing volume. The standard ½" diameter probe, built from Ti6Al4V titanium alloy with a replaceable tip, ships with the base VCX-750 configuration and covers general-purpose sonication work directly. Beyond that standard probe, a wide assortment of horns and accessories extends the system's effective processing range from 200 µL microsamples up to 2 L batches, with the specific range depending on which probe or accessory is fitted for a given application. Optional additions, a stand with clamp for hands-free operation, a sound enclosure for noise containment, and a dedicated temperature probe, round out the system for labs running it as a fixed workstation rather than a bench-to-bench tool.
